skins.name: Unruly Humbleness
skins.description: Bartender and bar-owner Lappland, with some of her colleagues in tow, happily welcomes in tonight's employer and Boss.

skins.name: Condolence
skins.description: Attire worn by Civilight Eterna during her Deep Dive into Theresa 's data. Through the veil of time, she spots memories sealed by the dead.

skins.name: Glorious Path
skins.description: Ceremonial clothes worn by Vina Victoria. The natural combination of black and white is contrasted with golden ornamentation, granting the wearer majesty and unbridled charm.

skins.name: La Valse Couronnée de Fleurs
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection/La Valse Couronnée de Fleurs
skins.description: Formalwear Estelle prepared for a ball. A classic white dress is paired with a sash belt adorned with a ribbon with dangling tails. The picture of grace, yet replete with the elegance of night.

skins.name: Ritual of Immortality
skins.description: Clothes Ho'olheyak wore while touring the ruins. Under a loose coat lies an exceedingly-modern black dress, making clear that her purpose here is not to explore the past, but to sneer at its passing.
